criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Alarm_Set
categories.definition: Create or configure a new alarm or a repeating alarm schedule.

categories.name: Alarm_Query
categories.definition: Check existing alarm status, list alarms, or ask for the next alarm time.

categories.name: Alarm_Control
categories.definition: Modify, delete, snooze, or turn on/off existing alarms.

categories.name: Reminder_Set
categories.definition: Create a new reminder for a specific task or time.

categories.name: Reminder_Query
categories.definition: Check, list, or read existing reminders.

categories.name: Reminder_Control
categories.definition: Modify, delete, or cancel existing reminders.

categories.name: Timer_Set
categories.definition: Start, set, or create a new countdown timer.

categories.name: Timer_Query
categories.definition: Check the status, time remaining, or name of a running timer.

categories.name: Timer_Control
categories.definition: Pause, resume, reset, stop, or adjust a running timer.

categories.name: Call_Make
categories.definition: Initiate a voice or video call to a contact or group.

categories.name: Call_Manage
categories.definition: Control an active call by adding participants, hanging up, or blocking.

categories.name: Call_Query
categories.definition: Check call history, logs, or specific call details.

categories.name: Message_Send
categories.definition: Send a text or video message to a contact or group.

categories.name: Message_Query
categories.definition: Check for, retrieve, or read incoming messages.

categories.name: Music_Play
categories.definition: Play music by artist, genre, playlist, or specific song.

categories.name: Music_Control
categories.definition: Control music playback such as repeating, skipping, or pausing.

categories.name: Music_Query
categories.definition: Identify the current song or request information about music.

categories.name: Weather_Query
categories.definition: Request current weather conditions, forecasts, or specific weather data.

categories.name: News_Query
categories.definition: Request news updates, headlines, or stories on specific topics.

categories.name: Calendar_Query
categories.definition: Check calendar events, schedules, or meeting details.

categories.name: Calendar_Control
categories.definition: Create, modify, or delete calendar events or RSVP to invitations.

categories.name: Contact_Query
categories.definition: Request information about a contact's location, work, or relationships.

categories.name: Recipe_Query
categories.definition: Search for recipes, cooking instructions, or food preparation advice.

categories.name: Nutrition_Query
categories.definition: Request nutritional information such as calories or fat content.

categories.name: Events_Query
categories.definition: Find local events, activities, or things to do in a specific area.

categories.name: Knowledge_Query
categories.definition: Ask general factual questions or definitions not covered by other categories.

categories.name: Status_Set
categories.definition: Set or change the user's availability or status.
